1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 c6 3.d4 d5 4.exd5.strategy: Takes first, so the pawn that attacked the bishop disappears and the e-file opens. The cost is the e-pawn, which until now held the centre together with d4, and Black recaptures with a gain of time on the bishop.

1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 c6 3.d4 d5 4.exd5 cxd5.strategy: Restores the material and attacks the bishop again, while the c-pawn leaves the file for Black's rooks. The e5 pawn is still attacked by d4 and has no defender, so the bishop will be able to move with a threat.
